title: Can You Bring Your Own Food and Drinks on a Private Boat in Madeira?
description: Ask the operator first. On Chifbay trips food, local wine, poncha, beer and soft drinks are included, so bring only a cake, a special bottle or allergy food.
heroAlt: Glasses of poncha and local wine on a boat deck table, Madeira cliffs behind in midday sun
